security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https: data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A portable, single-file WYSIWYG Markdown editor
bundle.longDescription: Monoleaf edits Markdown with formatting rendered in place, while the .md on disk stays the whole document and the only source of truth. Opening a file and saving it untouched reproduces it byte for byte.
